Credit Risk Analyst

Bank of China (HK) Hong Kong Full time

We are looking for a Credit Risk Analyst to join our Risk Management division.

Responsibilities

  • Assess credit & counterparty risk across the corporate loan portfolio
  • Prepare credit proposals and present recommendations to the Credit Committee
  • Monitor portfolio quality and flag early warning signals to management

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of credit risk or corporate banking experience
  • Proficiency in Excel; knowledge of SAS or Python is a plus
  • Strong written & spoken English and Cantonese
